places-faces-the-book.d: PLACES+FACES: THE BOOK Over a decade in the making—this is the definitive Places+Faces coffee table book. Nearly 500 pages capturing the raw energy, culture, and people who have defined an era. Featuring iconic images of Playboi Carti, A$AP Rocky, Rihanna, Travis Scott, Frank Ocean, Skepta, Jorja Smith, and many more, this book is a visual time capsule shot across the world—from Brazil to Tokyo, Lagos to Paris, New York, and beyond. Beyond the portraits, this book also showcases our journey through fashion and design, featuring imagery from past P+F collections and lifestyle pieces—including rugs, cameras, furniture, and more. This isn’t just another P+F book. This is THE PLACES+FACES…

about.sum:
The Origin: Places+faces began in 2013 when ciesay spent his summer in new york city — talking his way into hip hop shows and photographing artists in their prime element. whilst ciesay was busy in new york, soulz was back in london taking photos of the culture, concerts, and music artists over there. what started as two friends documenting the world around them became something much bigger.
P+f began as a way for ciesay and soulz to document the culture they're a part of — to travel, work, and have fun whilst doing so. thus, places+faces — the UK's lifestyle, music and photography brand — was born.
The Brand: From those early days shooting in new york basements and london back streets, places+faces has grown into one of the UK's most respected streetwear and creative brands. rooted in authenticity, the brand has always been about more than clothing — it's about capturing moments, telling stories, and representing a generation that lives at the intersection of music, art, and culture.
